name: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Holidays
notes: NERC holidays: the six additional off-peak days of North American power markets. A holiday falling on Sunday is observed the following Monday; a holiday falling on Saturday is not moved. Source: NERC Operating Committee, 'Additional Off-Peak Days' (NERC holiday schedule), as adopted for wholesale power peak/off-peak definitions in NAESB WEQ business practice standards.
